acceptance_authority: stage1_freeze.json; static historical counts are not current acceptance flags

coordinate_admission.200_8_Address: native coordinate retained; current matched Census input address bound to AFDC snapshot and address anchor within 250 m required
coordinate_admission.GPS_or_200_9_Point: valid finite native longitude/latitude accepted independently; precision labels are source evidence, not field verification
coordinate_admission.manual_override: disabled; no per-record coordinate override tables
coordinate_admission.osm_same_address: QA evidence only; does not replace AFDC native coordinates

equipment_and_access.members: charging_members.parquet preserves safe original source rows, connector/port counts, access restrictions, hours, pricing and networks
equipment_and_access.port_counts: never sum across source records without EVSE identities; scalar fields describe one eligible representative source
equipment_and_access.restricted_or_contradictory_member: not eligible; a clean independently eligible member can support the location

location_identity.merge: identical native AFDC coordinate plus complete normalized street/state/ZIP5
location_identity.same_address_distinct_native_points: retain separate locations; same address alone does not prove a shared charging position
location_identity.sampling_unit: one row per charging_location_id in chargers.parquet
location_identity.stable_id: SHA256 of native coordinate and normalized address; unknown-address singleton includes AFDC ID

quarantine: explicit removed/unavailable status or private-only access contradicting public E flag

road_access.method: native point to complete physical inventory on the common October graph; charging-purpose permission and source-frontage guard
road_access.permission: public charging cannot inherit invited-delivery authorization
road_access.roundtrip: reference largest directed SCC in both directions
road_access.threshold_semantics: distance QA only; retain source-safe unresolved rows outside default eligibility

scope_limit: potential charging locations only; connector/vehicle applicability, power, hours and queues remain separate parameter/model review; whole-CLE release not asserted
snapshot_registry: phase1_sources.template.json: charging station/census/units with independent acquisition metadata
status: national_method; internal Stage1 acceptance requires same-graph independent cohort certificate
